package.layout: codex-package.json layoutVersion 1, entrypoint bin/codex, execServer bin/codex-exec-server (new at 0.166.0), resourcesDir codex-resources (now also voice/), pathDir codex-path, target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl

packagedNotRequired.role: The standalone remote executor the package now advertises (codex-package.json execServer); the census and probes do not start it.
The bundled bubblewrap Codex falls back to when none is on PATH (the configWarning every linux census start receives).

standaloneAcquisition: pnpm surface:download extracts bin/codex alone from the same tarball; its digest equals executable.sha256. Without the companion the exec tool fails (findings C8).

baseline.note: Re-acquired for a same-platform comparison only; its executable digest equals the promoted linux-x64 digest in support/agents.json. Nothing from it is committed beyond these digests, the comparisons in README.md and the hand-merged `baseline` block of provider-mismatch-results.json (README.md, Method 6).
